violation_type.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Combining Ages With 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1703)
violation_type.short_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Combining Ages With 12 or Fewer Children
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection, one caregiver had a total of 12 children present. Youngest child was 10 months old with the oldest child being 11 years old.

finding_variants.text: During inspection, one caregiver had a total of 12 children present. Youngest child was 10 months old with the oldest child being 11 years old.
Obeserved operation with a total of 14 children in care, a 3 yr old in a classrooom with a 2 month old infant combining smallest child with another child over 18 months of age.

Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation has combined infants with children older than 18 months old during opening for more than 45 minutes. This has been corrected by additional staff being present and scheduled to arrive earlier.
In a group of children the youngest child was 14 months old and the older child was 36 months, the children were 22 months apart.
There were 4 children ages 4m-15 mo old observed with children 18-23 mo. There were 24 total children in the building.
